correctness.rationale: For an infinite iid uniform finite-field matrix, the leading-corner nullity D_n is a homogeneous Markov chain: up probability q^(−2d−1), down (1−q^(−d))² for d≥1, otherwise stay. Its zero-return generating function F=1−1/U with U=Σ a_{q,k}z^k and a=∏(1−q^(−j)), so joint probability of exactly b positive zero-visits ending at n is [z^n]F^b. Multiplying by q^(n²) gives exact integer count of GL_n with B_n=b. Drift to zero gives exponential first-return tails and aperiodicity. Renewal mean 1/c_q, variance (2A_q+c_q−1)/c_q², so analytic renewal-pole coefficient asymptotics yield conditioned CLT with asymptotic count variance 2c_q A_q−c_q(1−c_q)>0. Independently enumerated all matrices at q2 n≤3 and q3 n≤2 and matched exact renewal histograms. Fixed q, n→∞, all prime powers; finite samples alone not infinite proof.
